alt: Une clinic de batterie dans un magasin de musique, public de dos
consigne_scene: Wide shot of a drum clinic inside a small independent music store in the evening: a vintage drum kit with bronze cymbals and coated white drum heads set on a low wooden riser, the drummer's stool empty, walls lined with hanging cymbals and stacked drum shells all without any logo, three short rows of folding chairs with a small attentive audience seen only from behind as dark silhouettes, warm tungsten spotlight on the kit, soft haze

emplacement: Section Enregistrer à distance (accueil et page Clinics & studio)
alt: Un kit de batterie entouré de micros dans un petit studio d'enregistrement
consigne_scene: A small private recording room for drums: a vintage drum kit with coated white heads and bronze cymbals, surrounded by condenser microphones on black stands pointing at the drums, overhead microphones above the cymbals, closed studio headphones resting on the floor tom, dark acoustic foam panels on the walls, a warm desk lamp glow, cables neatly coiled on a dark rug, nobody in the room

emplacement: Fond des sections Dates et appel final (accueil et page Musique)
alt: La petite scène d'un club de jazz avant le concert, une batterie dans la lumière
consigne_scene: An intimate jazz club stage just before the show: a vintage drum kit with bronze cymbals on a small low stage in warm amber light, a deep red curtain behind, an upright piano partly visible in the shadow, a few small round tables with candles in the blurred foreground, light haze, nobody in the frame, the upper third of the image dark and calm for a title

alt: Un pad d'entraînement, des baguettes et un métronome sur une table en bois
consigne_scene: Still life on a dark walnut table, seen from slightly above: a round grey rubber drum practice pad, a pair of wooden drumsticks crossed on it, a vintage wooden pyramid metronome with its pendulum moving, a closed plain black notebook, warm lamp light from the left, deep shadows, nothing written anywhere

alt: Une baguette oubliée sur une scène vide, dans un rond de lumière
consigne_scene: A single wooden drumstick lying alone on the worn dark wooden floor of an empty small stage, caught in a round pool of warm spotlight, the rest of the stage fading into darkness, light haze, nobody, the upper half of the image dark and empty

alt: Une batterie près d'une grande fenêtre ouverte sur la campagne
consigne_scene: A quiet practice room in an old house with thick stone walls: a vintage drum kit with bronze cymbals near a tall open window looking onto green rolling countryside, soft golden late-afternoon light, a wooden chair with a folded towel, a small practice pad on a stand, nobody, peaceful and warm
